subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is "**ordinary**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given options.

 
 
• ​modern: 

 relating to the present or recent times as opposed to the remote past.
 
 
• traditional: 
 habitually done, used, or found.
 
 
• ordinary: 
 with no special or distinctive features; normal.
 
 
• **typical**:
 having the distinctive qualities of a particular type of person or thing.
 
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, "**ordinary**" is the appropriate word choice for the blank.
 
• The implied meaning of the given sentence is that the style and language of poetry were accessible to the common folks of the time.

​Hence, the correct answer is **option 3.**

The complete passage is: Poetry and novels became very *(1) popular* in the 18th century. Robinson Crusoe by Daniel Defoe was published in 1719. This is regarded as the first successful English novel. It is partly based on the true life adventures of a traveller called Alexander Selkirk. Jonathan Swift’s Gulliver’s travels was written in 1726 and (2) describes four imaginary journeys of a ship’s doctor named Gulliver. Poetry *(3) revolved *around British people and places. Poets also considered nature as a source of *(4)inspiration*. The poets wrote in a simple style and language so that the *(5)ordinary* masses could understand it.
